comment: STORY: SAVE THE PARK (port ADR-069). The SNES story's plot and cast (bible 5.2, SNES ADR-077: Mr. Grimsby of Grimsby Parking Co. will pave the park unless someone beats the Champs; you and PEPPER win the other seven teams' signatures on the petition first; the Gym Bros are on his payroll, the Twins are his niece and nephew; the Champs play with the park as the bet; Grimsby is only ever text, never a sprite), retold for the remaster with longer scenes. A chapter is a ladder team in order: its venue, its time of day, a twist (MOD_* names), the scene before the match, the scene after a win, and Pepper's word after a loss. A page is `who` (narrator, partner, captain, mate, villain, note: a Grimsby Parking Co. letter) and 1 to 3 lines of at most 46 HUD characters: capitals, digits, spaces and !?.,:-'/%+. `petition` on a win page shows the signatures.

lines: SATURDAY MORNING AT RIVERDALE PARK.
THE COURTS ARE FULL. THE COFFEE IS HOT.
THEN SOMEONE NOTICES THE NEW SIGN
ZIP-TIED TO THE FENCE.
NOTICE: THIS PARK WILL BE PAVED
FOR A 400-SPACE PARKING LOT.
HAVE A NICE DAY. - GRIMSBY PARKING CO.
FOUR HUNDRED SPACES! ALL MINE!
UNLESS...
UNLESS SOMEONE BEATS THE CHAMPS.
BEAT THEM, AND I'LL LEAVE YOUR
LITTLE COURTS ALONE. HA!
THE CHAMPS ONLY PLAY THE BEST.
SO WE BEAT EVERYONE ELSE FIRST.
I'M PEPPER. I'VE PLAYED HERE SINCE
I COULD HOLD A PADDLE. YOU'RE WITH ME.
EVERY TEAM WE BEAT SIGNS THE PETITION.
EIGHT NAMES, AND THE PARK STAYS.
SAVE THE PARK? SURE THING, SPORT!
RIGHT AFTER YOU BEAT US.
DAD, THAT'S NOT A JOKE.
THAT'S JUST A SENTENCE.
WELL, I'LL BE. WHERE DO WE SIGN?
KIDDO, GRAB A PEN.
I'M SIGNING IN GLITTER.
THAT'S THE RULE.
ONE NAME DOWN! NEXT, THE SNOWBIRDS.
THEY'VE BEEN HERE LONGER THAN THE NETS.
SHAKE IT OFF. LET THE SERVE BOUNCE,
THEN GET UP TO THE KITCHEN LINE.
DOWN BY THE LAKE, TWO LAWN CHAIRS
AND TWO VISORS WAIT IN THE SHADE.
A PARKING LOT? WHERE WOULD WE
PARK OUR LAWN CHAIRS, DEAR?
WE'VE PLAYED HERE SINCE 1962.
WE'VE PLAYED HERE SINCE 1962.
WALT, YOU SAID THAT TWICE.
IT WAS TRUE BOTH TIMES. LOSE, AND
YOU CARRY THE CHAIRS TO THE CAR.
DEAL. BUT IF WE WIN, YOU SIGN.
AND WATCH THEIR DINKS. THEY'RE SNEAKY.
OH, THAT WAS LOVELY. HAND ME
THE PETITION, YOUNG LADY.
SIGNED IN CURSIVE. NOBODY CAN
READ CURSIVE ANYMORE. PERFECT.
TWO NAMES! GRIMSBY'S GOING TO
HEAR ABOUT THIS.
THEY WIN WITH SOFT SHOTS. DON'T
SWING HARD AT A LOW BALL. DINK BACK.
DEAR MEDDLERS: I HAVE HIRED HELP.
REGARDS, GRIMSBY PARKING CO.
A STRETCH LIMO PULLS UP BY THE
DINOSAUR COURTS. TWO MEN STEP OUT.
THEY ARE FLEXING.
THEY HAVE NOT STOPPED FLEXING.
GRIMSBY PAYS US IN PROTEIN SHAKES
TO STOP YOU, BRO. NOTHING PERSONAL.
HE PROMISED US A GYM ON LEVEL 2
OF THE PARKING LOT. LEG DAY FOREVER.
THEY HIT EVERYTHING HARD AND FAST.
STAY BACK, BLOCK IT, AND LOB THEM.
BRO. BRO. WE GOT OUT-WORKED.
BY A DINK.
THE SHAKES WERE CHALK, BRO.
WE QUIT GRIMSBY. WHERE DO WE SIGN?
THREE! AND WE GOT GRIMSBY'S
HIRED MUSCLE ON OUR SIDE.
THE BALL'S FAST TODAY. SOFT HANDS:
LET THEIR PACE DO THE WORK.
DUSK. THE WIND PICKS UP ON THE LAKE.
A SHIP DROPS ANCHOR BY THE COURTS.
ARR! A PARKING LOT, YE SAY?
WHERE WOULD WE MOOR THE SHIP?
BEAT US FAIR IN THE GALE, AND WE'LL
FIGHT GRIMSBY AT YER SIDE!
THE WIND'S PUSHING THE BALL SIDEWAYS.
AIM FOR THE MIDDLE AND LET IT DRIFT.
ALL HANDS ON DECK!
ALL PADDLES ON... ALSO DECK!
BLOW ME DOWN. YE SAIL A FINE RALLY.
BILGE! THE QUILL!
WE SIGNED IT WITH AN X.
THAT'S HOW PIRATES SIGN.
FOUR! HALFWAY THERE.
AND WE HAVE A SHIP NOW, APPARENTLY.
THE WIND CHANGES EVERY SERVE.
WATCH THE STREAKS AND AIM INTO IT.
NEXT, THE GOTH CLUB.
THEY ONLY PLAY AFTER DARK. GULP.
THE STARS COME OUT. THE LINES GLOW.
TWO PALE FACES WAIT AT THE NET.
WE LIKE GRAY PAVEMENT.
IT MATCHES OUR SOULS.
BUT A PARKING LOT HAS SUCH
BRIGHT LIGHTS. ALL NIGHT. UGH.
THE KITCHEN IS OUR CRYPT.
ENTER IF YOU DARE.
THEY SLICE AND DINK ALL DAY.
BE PATIENT. WAIT FOR THE HIGH ONE.
YOU HAVE DEFEATED THE DARKNESS.
THIS IS ANNOYING.
WE SIGNED IN PURPLE INK.
IT'S THE ONLY INK WE OWN.
FIVE! SPOOKY, BUT SIGNED.
DON'T RUSH IT. THE WIN IS THE
SHOT AFTER THE ONE THAT'S TOO HIGH.
DOWN UNDER THE WAVES, THE SURF
CREW HAS BUILT A COURT. SOMEHOW.
NO PARK, NO HANGING OUT, DUDE.
BUT YOU GOTTA EARN IT.
DOWN HERE THE BALL FLOATS, BRAH.
EVERY LOB IS LIKE, A JOURNEY.
EVERYTHING HANGS IN THE WATER.
TAKE YOUR TIME. YOU'VE GOT IT.
WIN, AND THE WHOLE BEACH COMES
TO THE FINAL. COWABUNGA!
TOTALLY TUBULAR RALLY, DUDES.
WHERE'S THE PEN? IS IT WATERPROOF?
IT IS NOW.
SIX! TWO TEAMS LEFT.
AND THEN THE CHAMPS.
THE BALL HANGS FOREVER DOWN HERE.
DON'T SWING EARLY. WAIT FOR IT.
SUNSET. TWO KIDS IN MATCHING CAPS
ARE ALREADY ON THE COURT. WAITING.
UNCLE GRIMSBY SAYS HI.
HE SAYS YOU'LL NEVER GET PAST US.
HE ALSO SAYS EAT YOUR VEGETABLES.
HIS NIECE AND NEPHEW?!
OKAY. NOW IT'S PERSONAL.
I HAVE SENT MY BEST. FAMILY.
THEY HAVE NEVER LOST A POINT AT DINNER.
- GRIMSBY PARKING CO.
UNCLE GRIMSBY IS GOING TO BE
SO MAD. THIS IS GREAT.
WE'RE SIGNING. WE LIKE THE PARK.
THE SWINGS ARE THE BEST PART.
SEVEN NAMES! ONE LEFT.
THE CHAMPS.
THEY'RE QUICK AT THE NET. DROP IT
SHORT, THEN MOVE UP TOGETHER.
THE LIGHTS COME ON OVER CENTER COURT.
EVERY TEAM YOU BEAT HAS COME TO WATCH.
SO. YOU REACHED THE CHAMPS.
THEY HAVEN'T LOST IN YEARS.
I'VE BET THE PARK ON THEM.
THE WHOLE THING. TREES INCLUDED.
NOTHING PERSONAL.
WE JUST REALLY LIKE WINNING.
WIN BY TWO TONIGHT. NO LUCKY
POINTS. YOU'LL HAVE TO EARN IT.
THIS IS IT, PARTNER. EVERYTHING
WE'VE PLAYED FOR. LET'S SAVE OUR PARK.
...GOOD GAME. REALLY.
WE'LL SIGN. WE'RE NOT MONSTERS.
SAME TIME NEXT SUMMER?
WE WANT A REMATCH.
EIGHT NAMES. EIGHT!
THE PETITION'S FULL!
WE'RE CLOSE. KEEP THE BALL LOW,
STAY AT THE LINE, AND BE PATIENT.
THE CHAMPS ARE BEATEN.
THE WHOLE PARK CHEERS.
FINE! FINE. A DEAL IS A DEAL.
THE PARK STAYS.
NOTICE: THIS PARK WILL NOT BE PAVED.
WE ARE VERY UPSET ABOUT IT.
- GRIMSBY PARKING CO.
THE SIGN COMES DOWN. THE NETS STAY UP.
THE NEXT GAME STARTS AT NOON.
WE DID IT, PARTNER.
SEE YOU ON THE COURTS.
LATER, AS THE LIGHTS GO OFF, A MAN
IN A HEADBAND STOPS AT THE FENCE.
HE LOOKS A LOT LIKE THE GUY
ON THE BOX THIS GAME CAME IN.
DALE DAWSON WANTS A GAME.
FIND HIM ON MATCH SETUP: VS.
